answers.question: I missed Thursday and cut the long run short. Should I make up the miles next week?
answers.answer: Yes, add a 5‑mile easy run on Saturday or extend the long run to 13 miles to keep the total mileage around the same level as the previous week. This keeps the volume consistent while still giving you a recovery day after the quality session.
